🖥 Pezeshkian leaves for Tehran after attending summits in Turkmenistan

📌 Tehran, IRNA — President Masoud Pezeshkian has left Turkmenistan for Tehran after attending and delivering speeches at two summits that had brought several regional heads of state and representatives together to deliberate on issues of common interest.

Pezeshkian, who had traveled to Turkmenistan to attend the Council of Heads of State of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) and the Environmental Summit of the Heads of Caspian Sea Littoral States, left the city of Turkmenbashi for Tehran Friday evening.
​
During his two-day visit, he held meetings and discussions with the presidents of Russia, the Republic of Azerbaijan, and Turkmenistan, as well as the Prime Minister of Armenia and the Secretary-General of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO).
​
His speeches at the CIS summit and the Caspian Sea Forum focused on challenges the region is grappling with and talked about the importance of multilateral relations, countering unilateralism, energy cooperation, and other political, economic, social, and security matters.

🇪🇸🇬🇷🇺🇦 Spain and Greece refuse to hand Kiev their expiring Patriot missiles

Spain and Greece have declined to transfer Patriot interceptor missiles to Ukraine, even those close to the end of their service life, The Daily Telegraph reports, citing sources.

Greece holds around 200 PAC-2 missiles approaching the end of their 23-year lifespan, according to the paper. The size of Spain's stockpile is not known, though Madrid earlier said it was prepared to give Kiev five missiles.

The refusal comes after months of pressure from NATO and the EU. One scheme under discussion had Norway buying the missiles from Madrid and Athens and passing them on to Ukraine. Athens has consistently said it needs its air defenses for itself, pointing to its long-running rivalry with fellow NATO member Turkey.

Kiev's backers are running out of places to look. Germany and others say giving up more interceptors would put their own security at risk, and new production cannot quickly cover the shortfall.

If you're still here, I want you to read this.
ㅤ
Yes. YOU.
ㅤ
The person who has spent years wondering if you're the only one who sees that something isn't right.
ㅤ
The person who stopped talking about certain things at family dinners because you got tired of the arguments.
ㅤ
The person who lost friends because you refused to pretend you believed something you didn't.
ㅤ
The person who was called crazy.
ㅤ
Conspiracy theorist.
ㅤ
Extremist.
ㅤ
Dangerous.
ㅤ
Selfish.
ㅤ
Uneducated.
ㅤ
You heard it all.
ㅤ
And sometimes, when nobody was around, you probably asked yourself:
ㅤ
“What if I’m wrong?”
ㅤ
But instead of giving up, you kept searching.
ㅤ
You read.
ㅤ
You listened.
ㅤ
You questioned BOTH sides.
ㅤ
You changed your mind when the evidence demanded it.
ㅤ
And most importantly…
ㅤ
You refused to hand your ability to think over to somebody else.
ㅤ
That takes more courage than people realize.
ㅤ
Because standing with a crowd is easy.
ㅤ
Standing alone?
ㅤ
That's different.
ㅤ
Some of you paid a real price.
ㅤ
Friendships disappeared.
ㅤ
Families became divided.
ㅤ
People you loved stopped speaking to you.
ㅤ
Some of you learned the painful lesson that certain people only accepted you when you agreed with them.
ㅤ
And yet somehow…
ㅤ
YOUR HEART DIDN'T TURN TO STONE.
ㅤ
You still care.
ㅤ
You still pray for people who would never pray for you.
ㅤ
You still want a better future for children who aren't even yours.
ㅤ
You still look at this broken world and believe it can be saved.
ㅤ
Think about that.
ㅤ
After everything you've seen…
ㅤ
YOU STILL HAVE HOPE.
ㅤ
Never underestimate how powerful that is.
ㅤ
You don't need millions of followers.
ㅤ
You don't need to become famous.
ㅤ
You don't need to win every argument.
ㅤ
You don't even need everyone to understand you.
ㅤ
Just keep your eyes open.
ㅤ
Keep asking questions.
ㅤ
Keep your family close.
ㅤ
Help people when you can.
ㅤ
Admit when you're wrong.
ㅤ
Stand firm when you know you're right.
ㅤ
And above everything else…
ㅤ
KEEP GOD FIRST.
ㅤ
Because this battle was never only political.
ㅤ
It's a battle over fear.
ㅤ
Truth.
ㅤ
Faith.
ㅤ
Family.
ㅤ
And what kind of world we're going to leave behind.
ㅤ
So if nobody has told you lately:
ㅤ
I'm glad you're still here.
ㅤ
I'm glad you didn't give up.
ㅤ
I'm glad you're still searching.
ㅤ
I'm glad you still care.
ㅤ
And somewhere out there, someone else needs to know they're not alone either.
ㅤ
Send this to them.
ㅤ
Keep your head up.
ㅤ
Keep your faith stronger than your fear.
ㅤ
We may not know what tomorrow brings…
ㅤ
BUT GOD DOES. 🙏🇺🇸
ㅤ
If this message hit home, don't keep it to yourself.
ㅤ
Share it with someone who needs to hear it today.
ㅤ
You're not alone. And you're not done. 🇺🇸
